language.note: Entirely online English-language degree; students may study from any geographical location.

requirements.label: An upper-secondary qualification accepted as equivalent to UK Level 3; IBA assesses qualifications individually.
requirements.note: For applicants from Denmark the programme names STX, HHX, HTX, HF or equivalent; applicants from other countries need a qualification giving higher-education access at home and accepted as UK Level 3 equivalent. No programme-specific subject requirements are published. Coventry-course IB 24-point guidance is not imported into this LBU route.

openFor.question: How does IBA/Leeds Beckett assess your IB Diploma or DP Course Results for this online BA? No LBU-specific IB points or Course Results rule is published in the reviewed sources.

requirements.openQuestion: Confirm how IBA/Leeds Beckett assesses your IB Diploma or DP Course Results: this online BA publishes no IB-specific points threshold or Course Results acceptance rule.

requirements.label: English proof accepted by IBA and Leeds Beckett; IELTS 6.0 is one published route.
requirements.note: Applicants from Denmark need Danish English B equivalence. The programme lists IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 79 with at least 19 per section, CAE A/B/C or Oxford B2 with at least 70 per part. Prior education delivered and assessed in English or a first language of English may qualify for exemption under LBU regulations. The application form offers an English-taught IB Diploma but lists a conflicting TOEFL 65; do not assume a universal exemption or the lower score.

openFor.question: Confirm the applicable English proof or exemption: the programme and live form give different TOEFL thresholds; Course Results treatment and the conditions for IB English-medium proof need confirmation.

requirements.openQuestion: Confirm your English proof or exemption: the programme gives TOEFL iBT 79/minimum 19 per section while its form lists 65, and conditions for IB English-medium proof need confirmation.

requirements.label: Relevant professional experience may be considered; ranking weights and capacity are not published.

selection.description: Relevant professional experience is considered. An online meeting is offered; the programme does not label it a compulsory admission interview.

tuition.note: Total includes DKK 10,000 registration, twenty modules at DKK 6,500 and a DKK 15,000 research project; payment per unit at its start. No citizenship exemption stated. Books and separate application fee are additional.

outcomePathway.accreditation: British BA (Hons) degree awarded by Leeds Beckett University, delivered online through IBA; the September 2026 IBA announcement reports LBU validation in July.
outcomePathway.furtherStudy: A completed bachelor may support applications to postgraduate study; check the receiving programme requirements.

notes: The provider is based in Kolding, but this is entirely online and has no physical attendance Place. No Danish student-visa entitlement, IBA scholarship or SU is provided for this programme.
22 August 2027 is the published application/document closing date. A closing time, separate predicted-grade/final-IB-results procedure, reply date and offer-acceptance deadline remain unpublished.
No IB-specific admission threshold or Course Results acceptance/rejection is asserted. The award route remains for individual assessment.

officialRequirementsText.text: Upper-secondary education accepted as UK Level 3 equivalent; no specific subject requirements. English proof such as IELTS 6.0 is required unless an exemption is approved under Leeds Beckett regulations. IB award equivalence and the programme/form TOEFL discrepancy need individual confirmation.
